description: The '''Fallen Soul''' is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] and Fallen Arena [[PVP]] modes. It has a decent amount of health with above average speed. As it is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, only towers with hidden detection can target it.
